integrity: Analytic proof and a standalone executable reproduce the displayed formulas; numerical checks are not claimed as a proof of infinite crossings.
scientific_limitations: Exact four-state exponential run–pause–reverse stationary model with zero independent translational noise; independent priority and validation remain outstanding. The covariance trichotomy is proved, while general nonexponential or noisy extensions are not.
title: A tuned-cancellation window for oscillatory position memory in run–pause–reverse transport
